C23 and C09 contain weaker approval-of-recommendation patterns but lack C03's near-parallel memorandum structure and authorization formula.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have read your memorandum of today concerning the case of John Carter Vincent.","parent_excerpt":"Over a long period of time I have devoted considerable thought to various aspects of the problem which you discuss in your letter of today's date.","explanation":"Both open by recording presidential consideration of a same-day submission from a cabinet secretary."},{"child_excerpt":"I think the suggestions which you make are well taken","parent_excerpt":"The action which you recommend meets with my approval.","explanation":"Both explicitly approve the secretary's proposed course of action."},{"child_excerpt":"I authorize and direct you to proceed in the manner which you have outlined.","parent_excerpt":"Accordingly, I hereby authorize you to arrange for and carry out the transfer which you recommend.","explanation":"Both culminate in an express authorization to implement the course recommended in the secretary's submission."}]}
